meaning:
(P'al) to grow great
Aramaic of sa.ga (שָׂגָא "to grow great" H7679)

elsewhere.note: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.
